Calculate spatial matrisome-pair co-expression scores

Source: R/matrisome-pairs.R
score_matrisome_pair_coexpression.Rd

Computes spatially weighted co-expression scores for unique heterotypic MatriComDB pairs at each spot. The method measures whether one member of a pair is expressed in a spot while its partner is expressed in neighboring spots; it does not infer signaling direction or communication activity.

Usage

score_matrisome_pair_coexpression(
  seurat_obj,
  pair_db = NULL,
  adj_matrix = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  layer = "data",
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

seurat_obj

A Seurat object

pair_db

MatriComDB pair data with Gene1 and Gene2 columns identifying the two pair members. Defaults to package data.

adj_matrix

Sparse adjacency matrix for spatial neighbors. If NULL, computed from coordinates.

assay

Assay to use (default: "SCT")

layer

Layer within assay (default: "data")

verbose

Print progress messages

Value

Seurat object with a "MATRISOMEPAIR" assay added.

Details

Scoring Formula

$$Score_{spot} = \sqrt{Gene2_{spot}} \times \sum_{neighbors} \sqrt{Gene1_{neighbor}}$$

Pair members are alphabetically ordered before scoring so reciprocal rows collapse to one stable feature name. Homomeric rows are excluded.

Product structure: A score is non-zero only when both pair members are detected in the relevant spot and neighborhood.

Square Root Transformation:

  • Variance stabilization for skewed expression data

  • Reduced influence of highly expressed genes

  • Improved robustness to outliers

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
seurat_obj <- score_matrisome_pair_coexpression(seurat_obj)
} # }
